interventions.detail: Installed Python 3.11 via uv (Ubuntu 24.04 has 3.12), removed EXTERNALLY-MANAGED, symlinked /usr/local/bin/python3.11
Installed pipenv==2022.8.5 with setuptools<81 into python3.11 since pipenv needs pkg_resources
Ran install_deps steps manually: script requires sudo (absent) and installs docker-ce which is not needed
Datastore emulator needs Java 21+; installed openjdk-21-jre-headless instead of openjdk-17 from install_deps_linux.bash
Pinned google-cloud-cli and pubsub emulator to 591.0.0-0 too; gcloud 593 demands Java 25 for datastore emulator
Installed golang-go from apt for the local GCS emulator (go run emulators/gcs.go)
run.sh uses --skip-install-deps and PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 to avoid reinstalling deps on each start and get live logs
